{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the rank|the [[Republic trooper]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]], or [[Trooper (comic story)|the comic]]}}
{{Quote|Get up there, trooper!|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] calls to [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Draa/Legends|Draa]]|<ref name="WeaponsFactory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>}}
'''Trooper''' was a rank used in various armies, including the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The rank was also used by the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]].<ref name="CCG-Utris">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Trooper Utris M'Toc}}</ref> Trooper was sometimes used as a generic term to refer to Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] or other types of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

The "Suppression Troopers"<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref> active around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> wore their own [[Suppression Trooper armor|unique armor]].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> The rank of Trooper was used in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="WeaponsFactory" /> [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]], and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was equivalent to the rank of [[Deckman]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Troopers could be promoted to the rank of [[Senior Trooper]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
